verdict.rationale: Deel ships an official MCP server that exposes contracts, people, payroll, and time-off tools directly to conversational AI clients like Claude and ChatGPT, letting users invoke actions (e.g., createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts) via natural language, with MCP clients handling OAuth automatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of natural-language tool invocation in practice beyond first-party docs.
